blocking_finding.title: Schema closure ignores array arity/position; a mirrored rogue numerator in an edge tuple is semantically accepted with unchanged numerator FNV
blocking_finding.minimal_counterexample: In both current/ and historical/xs_qed_eedd_L1.json: d=clone(payload.edges[0][1]); payload.edges[0].push({...d, numerator:'0'}). Also with numerator 'garbage(' at edges[2] (num_interface removed from the clone), and eemm edges[4] numerator '-1'.
blocking_finding.result: round3 semantic-validate exit 0 (accept); reviewer FNV unchanged; only raw SHA (capture identity) rejects. One-sided variant rejects at exact non-owner comparison.
blocking_finding.also: Mirrored extra incidence element edges[i].push({source,target}) (eedd edges[2], eeee edges[1]) likewise accepted, FNV unchanged.
blocking_finding.cause: validateSchema collapses every array index to '*'; $/diagrams/*/payload/edges/*/* admits the union of the incidence signature and both edge-data signatures at any tuple position and any tuple length. removeKnownExpressions strips only edges[i][1].numerator, so edges[i][2].numerator is a numerator-named field outside every semantic owner that is never parsed, owned, or multiplied into the aggregate. This is the same class as X1-X4/X24 that round 3 claims to close ('mirrored unknown payload field all reject').
blocking_finding.narrow_remedy: Make heterogeneous tuples positional in the contract: require every payload.edges[i] to be an array of length exactly 2 with [0] matching only {source,target} and [1] matching only the edge-data signatures (or record allowed array lengths per pointer). Optionally also reject any key named numerator/numerator_prefactor/projector/*_interface outside the exact owner path set. Add G1m/G1m2/G3 as retained negative controls (expected reject, unchanged FNV) and keep the positive controls passing.

non_blocking: Leaf types and scalar-to-array changes are not part of the closure: mirrored aut 1->[1], symmetry_factor -> ['garbage('], source_slot number->string are semantically accepted, FNV unchanged, SHA rejects. Acceptable as capture-bound values if the report states the closure is on object-key signatures (not array arity, element positions or leaf types).

metadata model/options are pinned by sha256(JSON.stringify(...)), which is key-order sensitive: a mirrored, semantically neutral key reversal of metadata (V1) rejects at 'semantic-contract model/options'. Conservative; payload/owner key reordering is correctly accepted. Either canonicalize before hashing or do not describe JSON reordering as generally admitted.

Mirrored redistribution of a local factor between owners (move (-i) from edge:4 to edge:3, T5) is accepted with changed FNV; consistent with the stated limit that local values are cross-route equality plus capture binding, not derived.
verified: No expression/interface field is recursively stripped: removal is exactly payload numerator/numerator_prefactor/projector, vertices[i].numerator, edges[i][1].numerator and the matching *_interface fields; interface-like keys elsewhere reject by exact path scan (G1/G2/G4).

Object-key closure: unknown, missing and extra keys reject at payload and metadata paths (X1-X4, X23, X24, G8, G10); metadata is fully consumed (owners, model/options/grouping pins, report, case, id).

Owner bijection both sides, duplicate/missing/extra owners, live-expression binding, injective cooked decoding (14/row), closed constructor heads, ordered serialized interfaces vs live ports, bijective transports, port-hedge incidence, local-product factor multiset and Gaussian-integer coefficient (sums atomic, no distribution), full scalar contraction, group master/member/source/ratio chain.
Parser consumes the full string (trailing-token check), precedence is correct (T7 -i^2 accepted as +1, T8 (-i)^2 rejected, X8/X9), rational/zero-power/sum forms reject conservatively.

Equivalent forms still accepted: interface transposes (V3, prior), owner reorder (V7), payload key reorder, cooked alpha-renaming (X19), symmetric g swap (X20), whitespace (V6, X25), i^3/double-negation/power split (V4, V5, T2b, X10, X11).

Reporting honestly separates derived port-hedge incidence from capture-bound Q labels, AutG/aut/symmetry, cuts/keys/routing and observationally pinned dimensions/variance/flags/order; X14-X17 semantically accepted, all alter capture SHA, X16/X17 leave FNV unchanged as stated.
